model.detail: In {input} · out {output} · cache read {cacheRead} · cache write {cacheWrite}

refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_interval.description: How often the usage records regenerate. Opening the panel also re-probes the rate limits without rescanning transcripts.

disabled_agents.label: Disabled agents
disabled_agents.description: Agent ids to hide, one per entry: claude, codex, fireworks. Every discovered agent is enabled by default. A disabled agent is skipped when the records regenerate.

launch_command.label: Launch command
launch_command.description: What right-clicking the bar icon runs in a terminal.

sync_enabled.label: Synced aggregation
sync_enabled.description: Write this machine's usage snapshot and merge the snapshots from other machines. Rate limits and balances stay per-account and are never merged.

sync_dir.label: Sync folder
sync_dir.description: A folder synced by Syncthing, Dropbox, rsync, etc.

sync_file_name.label: Snapshot file name
sync_file_name.description: Optional. Defaults to <hostname>.json. Use a different file name on each machine, such as laptop.json or desktop.json.

sync_device_id.label: Device id
sync_device_id.description: Optional stable device name used inside synced aggregate snapshots.

glyph.label: Glyph
glyph.description: Bar icon, and the stand-in in the panel for an agent that ships no mark in assets/.
